The '''Obas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] which contained multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Obas]], [[Wego]] and [[Fal]]. The system's primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Oba]].<ref name="meltdown" />
